question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ambition
solution:
The correct answer is: **Laziness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Ambition**: A strong desire to do or achieve something. (महत्वाकांक्षा)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Intent**: Determined to do something. (इरादा)
 
• **Anxiety**: A feeling of fear, dread, and uneasiness. (चिंता)
 
• **Object**: A material thing that can be seen and touched. (वस्तु)
 
• **Laziness**: The quality of not being willing to work or use any effort. (आलस्य)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Ambition**' is '**Laziness**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
